# Data and Result Files

This directory contains simulation results generated by running the experiment scripts.

## Why are `.mat` files not included?

The `.mat` result files are excluded from the repository because they:

1. Are **large binary files** not suitable for version control
2. Can be **fully regenerated** by running the simulation scripts
3. May vary slightly depending on MATLAB/MOSEK versions and platform

---

## Files Generated by `experiments/Main.m`

| File | Size (approx.) | Description |
|------|---------------|-------------|
| `myResults_T30eps1.mat` | ~5–20 MB | Full results for T=30s, ε=0.01: Proposed (JTCD), Benchmark I (CD), Benchmark II (TD). Contains iteration structs `Itr_Prop`, `Itr_RAD`, `Itr_JTD` with trajectory, power, and scheduling data. |
| `myResults_T30eps5.mat` | ~5–20 MB | Same as above but for covertness constraint ε=0.05. |
| `AEE_IRS_scaled.mat`    | ~10 KB  | mAEE vs. number of IRS elements sweep (all 4 schemes). Variables: `AEE_IRS_scaled` (4×9 matrix). |
| `mAEE_freq.mat`         | ~10 KB  | mAEE vs. carrier frequency sweep (all 4 schemes). Variables: `AEE_kappa_scaled`, `fcVec`, `kfVec`. |

---

## How to Generate the Result Files

### 1. Set up MATLAB paths

```matlab
addpath(genpath('../src'));
addpath('../simulations');
```

### 2. Navigate to the results directory

```matlab
cd data/results   % so .mat files are saved here
```

### 3. Run the main experiment script

```matlab
run('../../experiments/Main.m')
```

> **Note:** The full script can take several hours depending on your hardware.
> It is recommended to run individual sections (clearly marked with `%%` headers in `Main.m`).

### 4. To run only specific experiments

For the **convergence figures** (Figs. 4–6 in the paper):
```matlab
% Run the first section of Main.m only (T=30, eps=0.01 block)
T = 30; epsilon = 0.01; N = 30;
SystemParams; Proposed;    % saves Itr_Prop, ATR_Prop, APC_Prop, AEE_Prop
SystemParams; Benchmark1;  % saves Itr_RAD, ...
SystemParams; Benchmark2;  % saves Itr_JTD, ...
```

For the **IRS elements sweep** (Fig. 10):
```matlab
% Run the "mAEE vs num of IRS elements" section of Main.m
```

For the **frequency sweep** (Fig. 11):
```matlab
% Run the "investigating fc kappa mAEE" section of Main.m
```

## Variable Reference: `myResults_T30eps1.mat`

| Variable | Size | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Itr_Prop` | struct array | Per-outer-iteration snapshots for Proposed (JTCD) |
| `Itr_RAD`  | struct array | Per-outer-iteration snapshots for Benchmark I (CD) |
| `Itr_JTD`  | struct array | Per-outer-iteration snapshots for Benchmark II (TD) |
| `ATR_Prop` | 1×K vector  | Min. avg. covert throughput per inner iter (Proposed) |
| `APC_Prop` | 1×K vector  | Avg. power consumption per inner iter (Proposed) |
| `AEE_Prop` | 1×K vector  | mAEE per inner iter (Proposed) |
| `ATR_RAD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark I |
| `APC_RAD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark I |
| `AEE_RAD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark I |
| `ATR_JTD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark II |
| `APC_JTD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark II |
| `AEE_JTD`  | 1×K vector  | Same for Benchmark II |

### `Itr` struct fields (per iteration):

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `.alpha`    | User scheduling matrix (K×N) |
| `.pa`       | AP transmit power vector (1×N) |
| `.pj`       | UCJ max AN power vector (1×N) |
| `.Qr`       | Cell: {qr (3×N trajectory), vr (2×N velocity)} for UIRS |
| `.Qj`       | Cell: {qj (3×N trajectory), vj (2×N velocity)} for UCJ |
| `.mAEE`     | Scalar mAEE at this outer iteration |
| `.APC`      | Scalar average power consumption |
| `.mACT`     | Scalar min. avg. covert throughput |
| `.AEE_Outer`| mAEE used for convergence check |

---

## Placeholder Files

The `.gitkeep` files in `data/raw/` and `data/results/` ensure these directories are tracked by Git even when empty.
